messages:
elaine: FYI opened a docs PR to migrate the Console observability snippets to the new Trace Context header + update the cost/latency widget examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/422 Need a quick review and a tiny SDK snippet tweak for Python/TS.

docs-bot: Pull request opened by @elaine — automated checks: linkcheck FAILED (1 broken link), spellcheck OK, build preview queued.

sam: looking now. quick note: the tracing example currently shows `X-Cloud-Trace-Context` which we should replace with W3C `traceparent` (we standardised on that last quarter). Also the snippet uses `route` instead of `endpoint` for the cost widget grouping — backend metric key changed to `route`->`api_route` in prod, so double-check.

maria: I can patch the Python SDK snippet. Do we want to show adding headers on the client or on the request-level? I think request-level so users can attach a trace for specific calls.

kevin: +1 request-level. Example I suggest (Python):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))

# attach W3C traceparent to a single chat request
resp = client.chat.create(
    model="redwood-chat-7b",
    messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}],
    headers={"traceparent": "00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01"}
)
print(resp.text)
```

elaine: perfect, thanks. I'll swap `X-Cloud-Trace-Context` -> `traceparent` and add that TS/Python snippet. Maria, can you also add a one-liner note about sampling: "we sample 1% by default, contact infra for higher sampling"?

maria: yep will add sampling note + small test case. Also found the broken link: the old dashboard JSON example points to `/dashboards/v1/schema` — update to `/dashboards/v2/schema`. I'll patch in the PR.

sam: small nit on the dashboard example text: when we call out token cost, use the term `token_unit_cost` (matches billing) not `token_cost`. Otherwise LGTM.

kevin: for the cost/latency widget we should include the JSON fragment we recommend. Proposed widget snippet (keeps it minimal for docs):
```json
{
  "widget_type": "cost_breakdown",
  "metrics": ["token_unit_cost","latency_ms_p50","latency_ms_p95"],
  "group_by": ["api_route","model"],
  "time_range": "7d"
}
```

elaine: nice. I'll include that and call out the metric name changes in a short migration checklist at the top of the page (old -> new keys).

docs-bot: build preview updated — linkcheck now passes for the patched URL, but there's a formatting lint on the SDK code block (line length).

maria: fixed the line length and force-pushed a tiny change to the PR. Also added the sampling note and a short troubleshooting tip if traces don't appear (check that `traceparent` header isn't being stripped by proxies).

sam: can someone confirm whether the Console requires `trace-id` to be 32 hex chars? We should call out the format if yes.

kevin: yes, W3C `traceparent` first field is version, second is 32-hex trace-id. I'll add a one-line example value and link to W3C: https://www.w3.org/TR/trace-context/

elaine: ok action items: (1) maria update Python/TS snippets + sampling note (2) me: add migration checklist and widget JSON (3) kevin: add W3C link and short trace-id format line (4) sam: quick pass on wording. I'll merge as soon as docs-bot greenlights lint. ETA EOD today. :rocket:

kevin: thumbs up. If lint blocks merge ping me and I can run the formatter in CI.

elaine: thanks all — will follow up in PR comments when done. :handshake:
